title: NeoAPI
description: A very simple API for NeoCortex's mods. Only used for NeoCortex's projects, or you can use it too!
body:
# NeoAPI

**NeoAPI** is a developer-focused Fabric framework for Minecraft 26.2 that gives mod authors the scaffolding to build their own tools, systems, and content. Rather than locking you into pre-built solutions, NeoAPI hands you the structure — you write the logic. It's designed to get out of your way and let you mod the way you want to.

> **This is a library mod.** It adds no content to the game on its own. Players only need to install it if another mod requires it.

---

## What It Offers

### Utility Method Framework
NeoAPI gives you a clean, consistent pattern for writing and organizing your own utility methods. Define your helpers once, share them across your entire mod, and keep your codebase tidy — no more copy-pasting the same logic into every class.

### Custom Event System
NeoAPI provides the backbone for building your own events. Define what triggers them, who listens to them, and what data they carry — all without touching a single mixin. Your mod, your rules.

### Custom Registries & Data Types
Need a registry that Minecraft doesn't have out of the box? NeoAPI gives you the tools to define and manage your own. Register whatever data types your mod needs and access them cleanly from anywhere in your codebase.

---

## For Mod Developers

Add NeoAPI as a dependency in your `build.gradle`:

```groovy
repositories {
    maven { url "https://api.modrinth.com/maven" }
}

dependencies {
    modImplementation "maven.modrinth:neoapi:1.0.0"
}
```

And declare it in your `fabric.mod.json`:

```json
"depends": {
    "neoapi": ">=1.0.0"
}
```

Full documentation and examples can be found at [your GitHub/docs link here].

---

## Requirements

| Requirement | Version |
|---|---|
| Minecraft | 26.2 |
| Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.19.3 |
| Fabric API | Latest |
| Java | 25 |

---

## Contributing

NeoAPI is built for the community. If you have ideas for new framework features that would help other mod developers, feel free to open an issue or pull request on [your GitHub link here].
